findings.summary: Connection-deadlines intro still says 'serves one session at a time, so a connection that never lets go locks every other client out: ... says nothing, ... stalls its TLS handshake'
findings.scenario: Since PR #176 a silent or stalled pre-auth connection holds one pre-auth slot, not the host (the same paragraph says so two sentences later); only an authenticated session blocks others

findings.summary: Slots bullet says 'behind an SSH tunnel or a reverse proxy every peer is loopback' unconditionally (also PreAuthSlots.hpp:30 'Useless behind a proxy', docs :678 'Every peer is loopback' under 'Behind a proxy')
findings.scenario: Contradicts the corrected text at :598 and the Host.cpp comment: a proxy or container on another network presents a non-loopback address that gets per-address caps

notes: All C++ hunks comment-only (strip-compare identical) except HostOptions.cpp raw-string help text (no )" introduced, delimiter lines untouched); CRLF preserved in all 11 files; Init reads exactly 4 settings, bad value -> unset/auto/off/false, reported by ApplyProjectSettings (ProjectSettings.cpp Read* with problems); no test/doc quotes the help strings; tests/ comments say 'behind a proxy everyone is loopback' (out of scope, conditional enough, not listed).
